| Period        | Operation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Daily         | Check oil level. Check readings on display.Check air filter service indicator.Check that the condensate is discharged during operation Drain condensate                                                                                                  |
| Daily         | On water-cooled units: check for cooling water flow.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 3-monthly (1) | Check coolers, clean if necessary. Remove the air filter element and inspect. If necessary, clean using an air jet. Replace damaged or heavily contaminated elements. Check the filter element of the electric cabinet (if fitted). Replace if necessary |
| 3-monthly     | Check that condensate is discharged when pressing the test button on top of the electronic water drain(s).                                                                                                                                               |
| 3-monthly (1) | On Full-Feature units: Check condenser of dryer and clean if necessary.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
